select bb.bookset_id as booksetId, /*账套代码*/ bb.subject_no as subjectNo, /*科目号*/ bb.balance_date as balanceDate, /*余额日期*/ bb.bal_flag as balFlag, /*余额方向*/ NVL(bb.b_amt, 0) as bAmt, /*原币余额*/ NVL(bb.b_d_amt, 0) as bDAmt, /*原币余额借方*/ NVL(bb.b_c_amt, 0) as bCAmt,/*原币余额贷方*/ NVL(B_CO_AMT,0) as bCoAmt, NVL(B_CO_C_AMT,0) as bCoCAmt, NVL(O_CO_D_AMT,0) as bCoDAmt, NVL(TDY_B_CO_C_AMT,0) as tdyBCAmt,/*取发生额合并修改别名*/ NVL(TDY_B_CO_D_AMT,0) as tdyBDAmt/*取发生额合并修改别名*/ from BOK_BALANCE bb INNER JOIN REP_PROD_INFO RP ON BB.BOOKSET_ID=RP.F_PROD_ID where RP.PROD_ID= #{booksetId} and bb.subject_no in('640301','640401','640601','640701','641110','660599','6701010001','6701020001','6701030001') AND to_char(bb.balance_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{mdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and RP.PROFIT_TYPE='01' ) b group by b.booksetId , /*账套代码*/ b.subjectNo, /*科目号*/ b.balFlag /*余额方向*/
